title: Tech Note: Building Applications Examples – Part 3 CS and SourcesFiles
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This is a niche, build-configuration-specific note from the mid-2000s XML-keys series; the specific file-bundling mechanism it documents (CS/SourcesFiles XML keys) reflects 4D 2004's project-file format, since substantially reworked in later 4D versions and especially by the shift to Project Mode.
related_updates: 4D's build/compile configuration model has evolved considerably since 4D 2004; component and source-file bundling is now managed differently in modern 4D versions
Project Mode (introduced 2018) changed how source files and components are organized and referenced during a build
